request.state:
L01: The door reader sits at shoulder height beside the frame.
L02: Its light is off when the reader has no power.
L03: A steady green light means the door is unlocked.
L04: A steady red light means the door is locked.
L05: A fast blinking red light means the reader has failed and needs a visit.
L06: The amber light is used for states that need no visit.
L07: A steady amber light means the reader is starting up.
L08: A slow blinking amber light means the reader has lost its link to the panel and is working from its stored list.
L09: The stored list holds the last two thousand cards.
L10: A card that is not on the stored list is refused while the link is down.
L11: The link usually returns within a minute.
L12: An operator can force the reader to reload from the console.
L13: A reload takes about ten seconds.

q1.instructions: Which line says what a slow blinking amber light on the reader means?
